_about: What each monster skill does on this server, read from the returntomorroc/ source (battle.cpp ratios, skill.cpp effects, status.cpp values, db/re/skill_db.yml). Joined to the mob_skill_db rows in server-mobs.json by monster.ts.

Per skill (Aegis name) and level: kind, element, ratio (% of the monster ATK or MATK per hit; object form = base + coef x stat), hits (damage multiplier of one application), ticks / tickMs (separate applications), area, status (what lands on the player, base chance before resistances), self (monster buffs), heal, summon. Schema: see the fields in monster.ts Effect.
hideBlocks here records the 2023 code, which let Boss and Detector monsters hit hidden players; the live server does not (the project owner, 2026-09-26), so monster.ts ignores it.
Edit freely: this file is hand-kept, not generated. Cite the source line in src when changing a number.

flat: damage added to each hit before DEF. flatCasterHpDiv: the caster's current HP divided by this, added likewise (Spear Stab). ratioAfterFirst: the ratio from the second cast on (Asura Strike spends all the monster's SP, which it never regains).
